recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: vintage machines humming in the browser
a failed cleanup somewhere in the privacy stack
summer fog rolling over san francisco
long july daylight stretching past eight
agents waiting to be spun up from a pocket

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Deploy micro-agents from your thumb — each tap sends a tiny worker to patch one bug before the error queue overflows.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: tap to deploy workers that collect/fix falling error tokens
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: clearing the full queue in under 60 seconds feels like shipping by sunrise
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: deploy cooldown shrinks and errors spawn in overlapping clusters
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon terminal glow on fog-gray background

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Route a flood of incoming kernel patches into severity buckets before the daily CVE counter hits 400.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: lane switch / sort incoming patches by severity
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: swipe left or right to route each patch
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: beat your personal patch streak before the overnight flood resets
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: duplicate CVEs split mid-air and false-positive decoys mix into the stream
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: amber monospace scroll on deep black

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Boot a phantom DOS machine — match floppy disk icons to boot commands before the blinking cursor times out.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: hold to peek at reference layout, release to flip disk tiles
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: one clean boot sequence in 45 seconds
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: IRQ conflicts add decoy disks and shuffle the command order
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: phosphor green CRT with heavy scanlines

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Draw one continuous path through Karl the Fog — link sunlight pockets before overcast swallows your route.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: draw a path through moving fog gaps
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: drag to carve route, lift finger to commit the stroke
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: linking three sunbreaks in a single unbroken line
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: fog tendrils creep inward and wind shifts the route mid-draw
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor bay morning in muted blues and gold
